e) Concerned about trucks crashing into Hamlin-Garland School.

g) Please see the response to Witness 11 on page 235.
A transcription has been included in the Official Transcript as requested by Corine Kuras.
20. a) Marcey Jaskulski 
c) Southeastern Wisconsin Coalition for Clean Air
d) 69
e) Represented Southeastern Wisconsin Coalition for Clean Air. Read the Department of Natural Resources comments and suggestions of September 11, 1973 on the Draft EIS. Indicated current air quality was not contained in the Draft EIS.
f) Agreed and supported the Department of Natural Resources letter.
Stated the EIS contained no monitoring data to indicate what the current air quality is in the area of the proposed project.
g) See pages 211 thru 224 for Statement Q and responses.
See pages 126 thru 136 for a response.

DNR's comments were satisfactorily resolved by submittal of Airport Spur Air Quality Report.
